title: Programmatic Duplication & Content Differentiation
root_cause: whatThisMeansSection/whatHappensIfIncorrectSection/quickTipsSection content arrays byte-identical across every page in a family; 4 of 5 FAQ answers identical verbatim; only H1/meta/computed table varied per page.

duplication.known_anomaly: ph family repeated_paragraph_blocks and repeated_faqs increased slightly (30->31, 4->5) despite largest similarity-score improvement; attributed to duplication-tool paragraph-boundary sensitivity, not a content regression.

remediation_applied: computed page-specific FAQ answers (real dosing figures per volume/level/size)
trimmed shared explanatory sections to one paragraph + canonical guide link
corrected shock-page CTA link from wrong chlorine-guide target to academy/sanitizers/shock-treatments-explained.html
display-precision fix: liquid chlorine FAQ figures .toFixed(1) -> .toFixed(2) (formulas unchanged)
intentionally_not_touched: 3 of 5 FAQ answers (overdosing safety, swim-wait timing, product-type guidance)

reproducibility.method: two independent full rebuilds of all 4 generator output directories, compared via SHA-256

scope_control.preexisting_unrelated_baseline_diff: sitewide one-line footer-link flattening (/charts/X -> /X) plus sitemap.xml/_redirects churn, present before this phase began, not introduced or altered by Phase 7G

remaining_review_queue: all 4 families remain HIGH risk; none reached LOW/MEDIUM
ph family repeated-block count anomaly (30->31, 4->5) worth revisiting if duplication tool is revised
hub-page section consolidation identified as the likely path below HIGH risk; not attempted (out of scope for this phase, would require design change)
